name: Donut chart
purpose: A part-to-whole summary with a visible total, category legend, and optional exact data table.
description: Show the distribution of a total across a small set of categories.

guidance.overview: A part-to-whole summary with a visible total, category legend, and optional exact data table.
usage: Use mutually exclusive categories that share a unit. Negative or nonfinite values are normalized to zero.
A zero total renders an empty state. Keep the number of categories small enough to compare and name totalLabel accurately.
accessibility: The chart provides keyboard category inspection; showDataTable exposes exact category values in native table markup.
The center total is decorative to assistive technology, so preserve the legend or table rather than relying on that number alone.
context: Use for distribution of a finite whole, and prefer bars when small differences between categories are important.
